help.title: How do I get this from Google Maps?

steps.title: Open Google Maps
steps.body: Open the Google Maps app on your phone and find the customer's house.

steps.title: Drop a pin
steps.body: Touch and hold on the house until a red pin appears.

steps.title: Share and copy
steps.body: Tap Share, then Copy link. The customer can also send you their location on WhatsApp — copy the link in that message.

steps.title: Paste it here
steps.body: Come back to this app, paste the link in the box and tap Save location.
